Marketplace ICO — did we take the car in? trade VIN join

Open the ABR KBB ICO desk — period selector, customer audit, later-purchase test.

What this answers Are Kelley Blue Book / ATC Instant Cash Offer leads (not the dealer-website form) producing cars we actually buy or take in trade? Join is the trade VIN on the ICO lead to VinSolutions inventory. Took-in = inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Dealer-website ICO (8 leads) is excluded. Marketplace = Kelley Blue Book + ATC Instant Cash Offer — not the dealer-website ICO form. Took-in = that trade VIN is in VinSolutions inventory with inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Appraisal ACV is not part of this test.

Source detail

Unique workable opportunities · Sep 17 – Oct 16, 2026 · de-duped · same funnel window · Close = sold ÷ opps · Response = average adjusted minutes (over 4 hours dropped from average)
What this means Drill-down on where demand came from — owned website vs Autotrader/KBB vs other portals vs OEM partner, then phone and walk-in. High volume + low close often means a source quality issue. Whether the team worked those leads fast belongs on the Handling tab. Dealer website includes Motive, store-domain forms/chat, and Carcode. KBB ICO cash offers are acquisition (not retail) — see Wholesale & acquisition. Autotrader/KBB is one 3rd party with many of their own channels. Response sits next to close so you can see whether slow first touch lines up with weak conversion. * on response = half or more timed values are 0 (common on phone/walk-in — weak signal).

Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. Funnel read Owned website + on-site tools (Motive, store forms/chat, Carcode) vs 3rd-party portals (Autotrader/KBB, CarGurus, Carfax…) vs OEM partner feeds. These sources create internet opportunities — and often later phone/walk-in on the same shopper.

Marketplace ICO — did we take the car in? trade VIN join

Open the ABR KBB ICO desk — period selector, customer audit, later-purchase test.

What this answers Are Kelley Blue Book / ATC Instant Cash Offer leads (not the dealer-website form) producing cars we actually buy or take in trade? Join is the trade VIN on the ICO lead to VinSolutions inventory. Took-in = inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Dealer-website ICO (10 leads) is excluded. Marketplace = Kelley Blue Book + ATC Instant Cash Offer — not the dealer-website ICO form. Took-in = that trade VIN is in VinSolutions inventory with inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Appraisal ACV is not part of this test.

How well are we taking care of the leads?
Speed and contact coverage when the CRM export includes them; how the team tries to reach customers (phone / email / text); retail close and open pipeline. Source mix lives on the Leads tab.

Date range: Aug 18 – Oct 16, 2026 (vs prior 60 days Jun 19 – Aug 17, 2026)
What this section is Handling grades for rolling 60 on unique opportunities after de-dupe. Bad CRM leads are excluded. Contact and speed grades appear only when the CRM export includes attempt fields.
Handling color legend
GoodKPI is in the healthy band for that metric
WatchKPI is middling — keep an eye on it
ProblemKPI is below the store target band
Per-card rulesInternet contact ≥90% good / <75% problem · response goal ≤15 min (after 15 = not good; ≥25% over 30 = problem even if median looks ok) · retail close ≥8% good / <5% problem · untouched 0 good

What this means Of internet unique opportunities (de-duped, excluding Bad), how many show a real work attempt — first contact attempt, phone/email/text, customer contact, or CRM contacted flag? Phone-ups and walk-ins are not in this grade — those are almost always “contacted” by nature and inflate the number. Higher is better. About 90%+ is good. Under 75% is a problem.

Store goal: first internet response in ≤15 minutes. After 15 min = not good. Over 30 min = missed goal.
≤15 min · on goal306 (69.5%)

Speed problem — missed goal: 68 timed internet leads (15.5%) took over 30 minutes. Store goal is first response in ≤15 minutes. 134 (30.5%) were after 15 min — that is not good. Do not let the median hide this bucket.
What this means Internet only, using VinSolutions adjusted response time when the export includes it. Phone-ups and walk-ins are not mixed in — they often show as 0 minutes and fake a fast store. Goal is ≤15 minutes. Any first response after 15 min is not good. The red over 30 min bucket is the problem list — read it even when the median looks okay. Bands: ≤15 on goal · 16–30 late · over 30 missed goal.

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. Marketplace ICO — did we take the car in? trade VIN join

Open the ABR KBB ICO desk — period selector, customer audit, later-purchase test.

What this answers Are Kelley Blue Book / ATC Instant Cash Offer leads (not the dealer-website form) producing cars we actually buy or take in trade? Join is the trade VIN on the ICO lead to VinSolutions inventory. Took-in = inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Dealer-website ICO (14 leads) is excluded. Marketplace = Kelley Blue Book + ATC Instant Cash Offer — not the dealer-website ICO form. Took-in = that trade VIN is in VinSolutions inventory with inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Appraisal ACV is not part of this test.

Source detail

Unique workable opportunities · Jul 19 – Oct 16, 2026 · de-duped · same funnel window · Close = sold ÷ opps · Response = average adjusted minutes (over 4 hours dropped from average)
What this means Drill-down on where demand came from — owned website vs Autotrader/KBB vs other portals vs OEM partner, then phone and walk-in. High volume + low close often means a source quality issue. Whether the team worked those leads fast belongs on the Handling tab. Dealer website includes Motive, store-domain forms/chat, and Carcode. KBB ICO cash offers are acquisition (not retail) — see Wholesale & acquisition. Autotrader/KBB is one 3rd party with many of their own channels. Response sits next to close so you can see whether slow first touch lines up with weak conversion. * on response = half or more timed values are 0 (common on phone/walk-in — weak signal).

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions. Data coverage — Lead export only covers Jul 18 – Oct 16, 2026. This window is partial (effective Oct 1–16, 2026). Closed-deal (DMS) history may still be complete.

Marketplace ICO — did we take the car in? trade VIN join

Open the ABR KBB ICO desk — period selector, customer audit, later-purchase test.

What this answers Are Kelley Blue Book / ATC Instant Cash Offer leads (not the dealer-website form) producing cars we actually buy or take in trade? Join is the trade VIN on the ICO lead to VinSolutions inventory. Took-in = inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Dealer-website ICO (5 leads) is excluded. Marketplace = Kelley Blue Book + ATC Instant Cash Offer — not the dealer-website ICO form. Took-in = that trade VIN is in VinSolutions inventory with inventory created on/after the ICO (minus 1 day). This is acquired metal, not a retail shopper conversion. Appraisal ACV is not part of this test.

How well are we taking care of the leads?
Speed and contact coverage when the CRM export includes them; how the team tries to reach customers (phone / email / text); retail close and open pipeline. Source mix lives on the Leads tab.

Pertinent handling numbers

Date range: Oct 1–17, 2026 (vs same days last month Sep 1–17, 2026)
What this section is Handling grades for month to date on unique opportunities after de-dupe. Bad CRM leads are excluded. Contact and speed grades appear only when the CRM export includes attempt fields.
Handling color legend
GoodKPI is in the healthy band for that metric
WatchKPI is middling — keep an eye on it
ProblemKPI is below the store target band
Per-card rulesInternet contact ≥90% good / <75% problem · response goal ≤15 min (after 15 = not good; ≥25% over 30 = problem even if median looks ok) · retail close ≥8% good / <5% problem · untouched 0 good

What this means Of internet unique opportunities (de-duped, excluding Bad), how many show a real work attempt — first contact attempt, phone/email/text, customer contact, or CRM contacted flag? Phone-ups and walk-ins are not in this grade — those are almost always “contacted” by nature and inflate the number. Higher is better. About 90%+ is good. Under 75% is a problem.

What this means Internet only, using VinSolutions adjusted response time when the export includes it. Phone-ups and walk-ins are not mixed in — they often show as 0 minutes and fake a fast store. Goal is ≤15 minutes. Any first response after 15 min is not good. The red over 30 min bucket is the problem list — read it even when the median looks okay. Bands: ≤15 on goal · 16–30 late · over 30 missed goal.

Organized as a sales funnel: website traffic → inventory health (active lot) → demand shape (VOI / trades) → CRM opportunities (site + 3rd party → internet/phone/walk-in) → handling quality (including how the team tries to reach customers) → salesperson execution. Unique opportunities after de-dupe (VIN/stock within 7 days, or same salesperson + day + vehicle). Internet + phone + walk-in on the same shopper counts as one. Headline contact rate is internet leads only (workable, de-duped, any real attempt). Internet speed uses CRM adjusted response time on internet leads only. Inventory panel uses VinSolutions live-lot units when an inventory export is present. Lead data: VinSolutions.
